subject: executor: Support Parallel Sort (#49705)
summary: Reviewed de16e0d^..de16e0d (first-parent diff). Change adds a parallel in-memory sort path in `pkg/executor/sortexec` gated by session sysvar `enable_parallel_sort` (default OFF), using worker-local batch sorting + multi-way merge, while keeping the existing spill-based external sort path for the default mode. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in touched executor/sessionctx behavior after checking later history up to `upstream/master`.
